title: Size and position of emblem icon depends on thumbnail's dimensions
line: Link and other emblems on desktop thumbnails now have the same size whatever the image's shape, matching the emblem on ordinary file icons.
explanation: Folder View gets its thumbnails from KIO's KFilePreviewGenerator, which added emblems with KIconUtils::addOverlays. That function picks the emblem size from the smaller side of the image it paints on, so a 21:9 thumbnail got a tiny emblem and a square one a large one. KFilePreviewGenerator now paints the emblems itself, sized from the view's icon size (same size table as KIconUtils), clamped to the thumbnail and placed in its corners, like Dolphin does since dolphin!917.

commits.message:
KFilePreviewGenerator: size overlays from the view's icon size

The overlays painted on previews were sized from the preview itself, so
emblems such as the link arrow were tiny on wide images and big on square
ones. Paint them with a size based on the view's icon size instead.

BUG: 499363

media.caption: Pure master: the link emblem on the 1:1, 16:9, 21:9 and 4:3 link thumbnails has four different sizes (tiny on 21:9).
With the fix: the same emblem size on every link thumbnail, matching the link emblem on the plain text file icon.
